name: Sentence-based Image Description and Search Benchmark
description: A benchmark collection for sentence-based image description and search, consisting of 8,000 images each paired with five different captions describing salient entities and events. It frames image description as a ranking task and evaluates models on their ability to rank captions for images.
reputation: An early and influential image-caption retrieval benchmark, but now largely superseded by larger modern vision-language datasets.
notes: Introduces strategies for collecting large-scale human judgments and compares human and automatic evaluation metrics for ranking-based image description.
